Subject: Your wrongful termination matter

Dear Mr. Sandhu,

Thank you for meeting us on 28 April 2025 about your dispute with M/s Sai Technologies Pvt Ltd. As we understand it, the employer withheld the last salary. The matter is listed before the Warangal Labour Court.

Our advice is to file a claim for unpaid wages before the labour authority. Please collect the attendance record and the salary slips and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of ₹45,50,000.

Regards,
Adv. Rohit Wadhwa
